name: Wake County Government
source_citation: Wake County Strategic Plan (adopted 2024, goals through 2029)
mission: Wake County will be a thriving community of opportunity where all residents enjoy healthy lives, economic prosperity, excellent public education, and safe, vibrant neighborhoods.
funder_affinities: Department of Housing and Urban Development
Department of Health and Human Services

goals.title: Community health and wellbeing
goals.citation: Wake County Strategic Plan (adopted 2024, goals through 2029), Community health and wellbeing page
goals.description: Community health and wellbeing: Create and preserve 2,500 affordable housing units by 2029; Make homelessness rare, brief, and non-recurring; reduce unsheltered homelessness by 10% from 2024 levels; Lower barriers to healthcare and behavioral health services.
objectives: 1. Create and preserve 2,500 affordable housing units by 2029
2. Make homelessness rare, brief, and non-recurring; reduce unsheltered homelessness by 10% from 2024 levels
3. Lower barriers to healthcare and behavioral health services
4. Lower barriers to benefits and assistance programs such as food, utilities, childcare and employment services
5. Increase by 4% the veterans and families accessing earned benefits

goals.title: Growth, land use and environment
goals.citation: Wake County Strategic Plan (adopted 2024, goals through 2029), Growth, land use and environment page
goals.description: Growth, land use and environment: Direct 97% of growth to cities and towns with municipal services; Increase public transit ridership by 10%; Protect 1,000 acres of green space, parks, greenways, farmland and forests.
objectives: 1. Direct 97% of growth to cities and towns with municipal services
2. Increase public transit ridership by 10%
3. Protect 1,000 acres of green space, parks, greenways, farmland and forests
4. 95% of residents with easy access to clean water
5. Progress toward 80% clean energy for county government by 2035

goals.title: Inclusive prosperity
goals.citation: Wake County Strategic Plan (adopted 2024, goals through 2029), Inclusive prosperity page
goals.description: Inclusive prosperity: Lower barriers to employment such as broadband, childcare and transportation; Four in five residents with employment opportunities right for their needs; Nine in ten residents can find enriching experiences.
objectives: 1. Lower barriers to employment such as broadband, childcare and transportation
2. Four in five residents with employment opportunities right for their needs
3. Nine in ten residents can find enriching experiences

goals.title: Lifelong learning
goals.citation: Wake County Strategic Plan (adopted 2024, goals through 2029), Lifelong learning page
goals.description: Lifelong learning: Increase income-eligible preschool slots by 33%; Increase access to quality educational opportunities; Develop baseline metrics for education-based support services in Wake County Public Schools.
objectives: 1. Increase income-eligible preschool slots by 33%
2. Increase access to quality educational opportunities
3. Develop baseline metrics for education-based support services in Wake County Public Schools
4. High-quality education facilities, including schools and libraries

goals.title: Safer community together
goals.citation: Wake County Strategic Plan (adopted 2024, goals through 2029), Safer community together page
goals.description: Safer community together: 80% of county public safety calls receive an appropriate and timely emergency response; Develop baseline metrics for referrals to recovery support networks; Reduce the violent crime rate by 5%.
objectives: 1. 80% of county public safety calls receive an appropriate and timely emergency response
2. Develop baseline metrics for referrals to recovery support networks
3. Reduce the violent crime rate by 5%

goals.title: Foundations of service
goals.citation: Wake County Strategic Plan (adopted 2024, goals through 2029), Foundations of service page
goals.description: Foundations of service: Maintain AAA bond ratings; Increase employee satisfaction to 90%; Residents agree services are high-quality, fair and equitable.
objectives: 1. Maintain AAA bond ratings
2. Increase employee satisfaction to 90%
3. Residents agree services are high-quality, fair and equitable
4. Better resident engagement and public input
